name: Soybean Crush Spread
description: CBOT board crush spread: processing margin from converting 1 bushel of soybeans into 44 lbs meal + 11 lbs oil. Formula: 11×ZL/100 + 44×ZM/2000 − ZS/100 ($/bushel). Shows crush margin with 252d moving average, rolling z-score for rich/cheap signals, monthly seasonality, and extreme z-score event markers.
source:
# Soybean Crush Spread — CBOT Board Crush
# Formula: 11 lbs oil × ZL/100 + 44 lbs meal × ZM/2000 − ZS/100
# All converted to $/bushel. NoAdjustment for absolute price levels.

# --- Data: Load all three legs via reference_futures + continuation ---
zs_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZS')()
zs = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zs_raw.o, zs_raw.h, zs_raw.l, zs_raw.c, zs_raw.v, zs_raw.oi, zs_raw.s)

zm_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZM')()
zm = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zm_raw.o, zm_raw.h, zm_raw.l, zm_raw.c, zm_raw.v, zm_raw.oi, zm_raw.s)

zl_raw = reference_futures(ticker='ZL')()
zl = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment
)(zl_raw.o, zl_raw.h, zl_raw.l, zl_raw.c, zl_raw.v, zl_raw.oi, zl_raw.s)

# --- Crush Spread Calculation ---
# ZS: cents/bushel → $/bushel = ZS/100
# ZM: $/short ton → 44 lbs meal per bushel = 44 × ZM/2000
# ZL: cents/lb → 11 lbs oil per bushel = 11 × ZL/100
bean_cost = zs.c / 100.0
meal_revenue = 44.0 * zm.c / 2000.0
oil_revenue = 11.0 * zl.c / 100.0
crush_margin = meal_revenue + oil_revenue - bean_cost

# --- Moving average for trend context ---
crush_ma = ma(period=252, type=MAType.sma)(crush_margin)

# --- Z-score: is the crush historically rich or cheap? ---
crush_z = zscore(window=252)(crush_margin)

# --- Seasonality: extract month for grouping ---
ts = index().value
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(ts)

# --- Event markers: extreme z-score readings (>2σ or <-2σ) ---
is_rich = is_valid(crush_z) and crush_z > 2.0
is_cheap = is_valid(crush_z) and crush_z < -2.0
is_extreme = is_rich or is_cheap
extreme_label = conditional_select(is_rich, "Rich", is_cheap, "Cheap", "Normal")

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Crush Spread Extreme',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Crush Margin', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Z-Score', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Signal', type=CardRenderType.BadgeFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(crush_margin, crush_z, extreme_label, is_extreme)

# --- Chart 1: Crush Margin with 1Y MA overlay ---
xy_lines(
    title='Soybean Crush Margin — Where Are We?',
    category='Crush Spread',
    y_axis_label='$/bushel',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crush Margin', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    overlay_series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='252d MA', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=crush_margin, overlays=crush_ma)

# --- Chart 2: Z-Score — Rich or Cheap? ---
xy_lines(
    title='Is the Crush Rich or Cheap? (252d Z-Score)',
    category='Crush Spread',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Crush Z-Score', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Fair Value'),
        ReferenceLine(value=2.0, color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Rich (+2σ)'),
        ReferenceLine(value=-2.0, color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Cheap (−2σ)')
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=-2.0, to=2.0, color=Color.Blue, opacity=0.05)
    ]),
    order=2
)(x_values=ts, y_values=crush_z)

# --- Chart 3: Monthly Seasonality — When Does the Crush Widen/Narrow? ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Crush Margin Seasonality (Avg by Month)',
    category='Crush Spread',
    x_axis_label='Month',
    y_axis_label='Avg $/bushel',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    x_category_type=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Breakeven')
    ]),
    order=3
)(values=crush_margin, label=month_num)

# --- Summary Table: Key Stats (2 rows × 3 cols = 6 cells = 6 inputs) ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Crush Spread',
    order=0,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Crush Spread Dashboard',
        row_size=2, col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Current', 'Historical'],
        col_headers=['Margin ($/bu)', 'Z-Score', '252d Avg ($/bu)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median,
                       type=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median,
                       type=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                       type=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(crush_margin, crush_z, crush_ma, crush_margin, crush_z, crush_ma)
